# LB1 final LoRA adapter (attached artifact)

- The 1st-place team attached the **final LoRA adapter** (rank 32 / alpha 32) as a non-code artifact to the writeup.
- Produced by main SFT (~119h, LR 2e-4, 1 epoch) + a bit-weighted continuation (~51h, LR 1e-5, 6,500 steps),
  framework **Unsloth**, on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell.
- Selected submission = the extra-trained adapter (submitted twice). Private 0.920; best *unselected* 0.932.
- **Not downloaded** (adapter weights ≫ 20 MB; the page is JS-gated and this task forbids downloads/credentials).
